title: Trump names commentator Katie Zacharia as White House press secretary
dek: The job has been vacant since Karoline Leavitt left in August.
what: President Trump announced on Friday 9 October that Katie Zacharia will be White House press secretary, CBS News reports. He announced it on Truth Social.

Zacharia is a conservative commentator who appears on Fox News and Newsmax. CBS says she is a senior communications adviser at Trump Media, which runs Truth Social, and was a Department of Homeland Security spokesperson. CBS says she has undergraduate and law degrees from Pepperdine.
She replaces Karoline Leavitt, who left at the end of August to spend time with her family, according to reporting at the time. CBS reports there have been no official briefings since 3 September.
Trump called her a loyal supporter from the beginning, CBS reports. I found no start date.
why: The press secretary speaks for the White House to reporters, and the post has been empty for weeks.

sources.label: CBS News: Trump picks Katie Zacharia as next White House press secretary
